description: This file defines a custom exception class InvalidDateInputException used in the Fineract platform to handle invalid date input errors related to teller operations. It extends an exception class from the core infrastructure indicating it's thrown when date validation fails.

classes.name: InvalidDateInputException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating invalid date input errors, specifically when end date is before start date.

methods.name: InvalidDateInputException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific error message about date validation failure.
